rounds.sentence: Vula iwindi, umoya awungeni kahle ekamelweni.
rounds.story: 'iwindi' ne 'ekamelweni' kusikhombisa umoya wokungenisa indawo, hhayi umphefumulo noma isimo sengqondo.

rounds.sentence: Geza izicathulo zakho, zigcwele umhlaba wasegcekeni.
Ekhaya sikhuluma ulimi lwesiZulu nsuku zonke.
rounds.story: 'sikhuluma' no 'lwesiZulu' kucacisa ukuthi 'ulimi' lapha luyindlela yokukhuluma yesizwe.

rounds.sentence: Inhliziyo yedolobha yilapho isikole sethu sikhona.
rounds.story: 'yedolobha' iyisihluthulelo. Akukhulunywa ngesitho somzimba, kodwa maphakathi nedolobha.

rounds.sentence: Sahlala ngaphansi komuthi ngoba isithunzi sawo sipholile.
rounds.story: 'ngaphansi komuthi' no 'sipholile' kukhomba umthunzi owenziwa ukukhanya.
'lomdlalo' no 'abadlali abazifudumezayo' kubopha incazelo yenkundla yokudlala.

rounds.sentence: Sebenzisa ikhanda ngaphambi kokuphendula lo mbuzo.
rounds.story: 'ngaphambi kokuphendula' kusho ukucabanga. Lapha 'ikhanda' lisho ingqondo nokuhlakanipha.
'lwetafula' luyacacisa ukuthi 'unyawo' luwumlenze wetafula, hhayi unyawo lomuntu.
'wakithi' iyisihluthulelo. Lapha 'umuzi' yikhaya lezihlobo noma indawo yomndeni.
'sewashi' no 'sikhomba ku 12' kukhombisa ukuthi 'isandla' lapha yinxenye yewashi.

kids.story: 'igcwele' no 'ikhanyisa igceke' kukhomba into esibhakabhakeni. Umelaphi noma uchwepheshe akukhanyi ebusuku.

kids.sentence: Umoya upholise ubuso bami ngesikhathi sigijima.
kids.story: 'upholise ubuso' nethi 'sigijima' kukhomba umoya ovunguzayo. Isimo sengqondo asipholisi ubuso.
'isifundo sezibalo' yilo mkhondo. Lapha bamba lisho ukuqonda, hhayi ukubopha noma ukubamba ngesandla.

kids.sentence: Shaya ucingo kuMama uma usufikile esikoleni.
kids.story: 'ucingo' no 'uma usufikile' kukhomba ukubiza ngocingo. Awushayi isigubhu kuMama lapha.
'uye esitolo' kukhomba ukuya endaweni. Iwashi lingahamba, kodwa aliyi esitolo.
'ibhola' nethi 'emva kwesikole' kukhomba umdlalo. Ihlaya noma insimbi yomculo akuhambisani nalapha.

kids.sentence: Ilanga liphuma emva kwamafu, sajabula enkundleni.
kids.story: 'Ilanga' no 'emva kwamafu' kukhomba ukuvela. Akusho ukuphuma ekamelweni.
'izinkomishi etafuleni' kukhomba ukubala ngenani. Akusikho ukufunda incwadi noma ukulandisa indaba.
'ucingo' no 'etafuleni' kukhomba umsindo wokukhala. Akekho okhalayo ngezinyembezi lapha.

kids.sentence: Leli bhola libiza imali encane esitolo.
kids.story: 'imali encane' yikhona okubonisa intengo. Lapha biza akusho ukubiza umuntu ngegama.
